name: WireGuard Easy
tagline: WEB UI to manage WireGuard VPN.
description: You have found the easiest way to install & manage WireGuard on any Linux host!

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  wg-easy:
    image: ghcr.io/wg-easy/wg-easy:13
    restart: unless-stopped
    network_mode: bridge
    environment:
      PASSWORD: 'casaos'
      WG_HOST: 'casaos.local'
      WG_PORT: '51820'
      WG_DEFAULT_DNS: '1.1.1.1'
    ports:
      - target: 51820
        published: "51820"
        protocol: udp
      - target: 51821
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/wireguard
        target: /etc/wireguard
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
      - SYS_MODULE
    sysctls:
      - net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
      - net.ipv4.conf.all.src_valid_mark=1
    container_name: wg-easy
